title: Groam release environments
description: Public settings for each hosted environment. Secrets never go here; they live in the matching GitHub environment. An empty string means not configured yet; `just deploy preflight` rejects it.

convexUrl.description: The Convex production deployment URL, from the project's dashboard.

cloudflareAccountId.description: Only needed when the Cloudflare token can reach several accounts.

workersSubdomain.description: The account's workers.dev subdomain (`my-team` or `my-team.workers.dev`). Version preview URLs are off, so Void checks each new version there before it takes traffic.

emailFrom.description: Sender of authentication mail, optionally with a display name; Void sets up Cloudflare Email for its domain.

worker.description: The Cloudflare Worker that Void deploys this app to.

host.description: The custom domain Void attaches to that Worker: a bare hostname, never a Convex one.
